content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks online

Conventional platforms like Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle position themselves as "all-in-one" solutions. They handle hosting, payment processing, and delivery—for a price. Gumroad takes 10% plus payment fees. Lemon Squeezy charges 5% plus Stripe’s 2.9% + $0.30. Paddle’s fees vary but average 10–15%. All require you to use their payment processors, which exclude Nigeria. In contrast, sovereign stacks like COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provide base-layer infrastructure you own. This includes GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and Google Drive for file delivery. Payment processing uses NOWPayments, which accepts 300+ cryptocurrencies with a flat 0.5% fee and no KYC. The stack is deployed in 48 hours, configured for your products, and handed over with full ownership. No subscriptions. No platform lock-in. No revenue share beyond the initial cost. The tradeoff is clear: convenience vs. sovereignty. Conventional platforms are easier to start but permanently rent your infrastructure. Sovereign stacks require initial setup but give you permanent ownership and control.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Conventional platforms exclude Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and other regions not because they want to, but because their payment processors (Stripe, PayPal) do. This exclusion is baked into their architecture. Even if a platform wanted to support Nigerian creators, they couldn’t without replacing their entire payment stack. Sovereign infrastructure solves this by decoupling payment processing from platform logic. NOWPayments handles crypto transactions directly, bypassing centralized payment networks. This isn’t a workaround—it’s a structural alternative. The Edge Commerce Stack deploys this architecture on Cloudflare and Supabase, both of which operate globally without geographic restrictions. Your store runs on infrastructure that doesn’t care where you’re located. The result is permanent inclusion, not temporary access. Conventional platforms will always exclude someone. Sovereign stacks exclude no one because they’re built on open protocols.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Conventional platforms process payments through Stripe or PayPal, which take 2–7 days to settle funds. They also charge 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction plus their platform fee. For a $20 ebook, that’s $1.58 in fees before taxes. Crypto payments through NOWPayments settle on-chain within minutes and cost 0.5%—$0.10 on the same $20 sale. Recommended networks like BSC and Solana keep transaction fees under $0.10. The Edge Commerce Stack integrates NOWPayments automatically, firing delivery webhooks the moment payment confirms. Conventional platforms also charge monthly fees or revenue shares. Gumroad’s Pro plan is $10/month. Lemon Squeezy takes 5%. Sovereign stacks charge a one-time fee. The Edge Commerce Stack is $197, deployed once, owned forever. Over 12 months, selling 50 ebooks/month, conventional platforms cost $1,200+ in fees. The sovereign stack costs $197. The math is straightforward: renting infrastructure is more expensive than owning it.
Conventional platforms exclude Nigeria. Sovereign stacks include everyone by design.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Conventional platforms own your customer data, payment history, and delivery logic. If they shut down or ban your account, you lose everything. Gumroad and Paddle have been known to suspend accounts without warning. Sovereign stacks give you full ownership of your infrastructure. The Edge Commerce Stack deploys your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, with backend logic in Cloudflare Workers. Orders are stored in Supabase, and files are delivered from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. COREMERCH configures and hands over the entire stack with no ongoing access. Automation is handled through webhooks and serverless functions. When a payment confirms on NOWPayments, a webhook triggers file delivery and sends the customer an email. Everything runs automatically without monthly fees. Conventional platforms automate delivery too, but they control the process. With a sovereign stack, you control the process—and can modify it as needed. The tradeoff is clear: convenience now vs. ownership forever.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re selling ebooks in Nigeria and need a solution today, conventional platforms are not an option—they’ve already excluded you. Sovereign infrastructure is your only structural alternative. The Edge Commerce Stack is ideal if you’re selling 3–10 products, need instant delivery, and want full ownership of your commerce stack. It’s a one-time $197 investment that pays for itself after selling 20 ebooks. If you’re selling fewer than 3 products and don’t need advanced features, the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) may suffice. For those who want to build their own stacks, The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides full documentation and source code. The choice comes down to this: Do you want to rent infrastructure that excludes you, or own infrastructure that includes you? Conventional platforms are temporary solutions. Sovereign stacks are permanent architecture. Choose based on what you’re building—not what you’re renting.

Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use Naira (NGN) for payments?

No. Sovereign stacks use cryptocurrency payments through NOWPayments, which accepts 300+ currencies but settles in crypto. Customers can pay using stablecoins like USDT or local crypto exchanges that support NGN to crypto conversions. This bypasses currency controls and enables global transactions.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments operates as a non-custodial payment gateway, meaning it doesn’t hold your funds. If their service experiences downtime, payments simply won’t process until it’s back up. Your stack remains operational, and you retain full access to your infrastructure. This is no different from Stripe or PayPal outages.
How do I handle refunds?

Refunds are processed manually by sending the equivalent crypto amount back to the customer’s wallet. The Edge Commerce Stack includes a refund guide in its documentation. Since you own the infrastructure, you control the refund process directly—no platform approval required.
Can I sell physical products with this stack?

No. The Edge Commerce Stack is designed for digital products with instant delivery. Physical products require shipping integration, inventory management, and additional backend logic. COREMERCH offers separate stacks for physical goods, but they are not included in this product.
What if I need to update my products?

Since you own the infrastructure, you can update product details (title, description, price, file links) directly in the Supabase or Google Sheets database. The Edge Commerce Stack includes a guide for making these updates without disrupting sales.
